name: TimeZoneMeetingPlanner
tagline: The Time Zone Meeting Planner helps you choose a meeting time for people in different countries.
description: The Time Zone Meeting Planner helps you choose a meeting time for people in different countries. It shows one day as a timeline with a row for each time zone, so you can see at a glance what time it will be for everyone, and whether that is during their working day, in the evening, at night or at the weekend.
features: A day timeline per zone with working hours
Suggested times where everyone is in working hours (or the fewest people outside), add/remove/re-home zones, day navigation
Per-zone summary with status and warnings
A phone list layout with filters
Stores the start as an ISO UTC date-time
No network or API key needed
